§3§lMatrix Supplies, Machine Processes§r
The matrix §1supplies materials in order§r; the native machine still checks recipes, consumes materials and produces outputs. The machine must be §1formed, properly powered and have output space§r. Assembly lines also need the §1corresponding research§r and §1item output protection§r enabled.

§3§lIf Processing Cannot Start§r
First read the §1reason§r shown in the compartment interface, then check the machine state, ME power, channels and the single entry. Get a §1regular matrix working§r before connecting a mirror to help distinguish source-group, binding and destination-machine issues.
